issues.detail: Instructions only cover TypeScript usage, lacking guidance for Python or Go.

scenarios.name: click-dynamic-subscribe-button
scenarios.rationale: Response B meets all rubric requirements with a stagehand.act call and no hard‑coded selectors, while Response A lacks a stagehand.act call and includes hard‑coded selectors.

scenarios.name: extract-top-10-products
scenarios.rationale: Response B includes a stagehand.extract call but the Zod schema uses a 'title' field and allows up to 10 items, not exactly 10 with a 'name' field; Response A lacks a stagehand.extract call entirely.

scenarios.name: secure-login
scenarios.rationale: Response B meets most rubric requirements but omits cache or logging settings; Response A fails to meet any requirement.
